reason: Automates narrowly matched DeepSeek Harness sandbox escalation approvals by routing bounded context and tool arguments to a tool-less reviewer that returns allow or deny, with configurable failure handling.

summaries.zh: 这是一个为 DeepSeek Harness 自动审核沙箱升级请求的插件，通过一次性无工具审查代理对匹配的请求返回允许或拒绝决定。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that automates matched sandbox escalation approvals through a one-shot tool-less reviewer returning an allow or deny decision.

capabilities: Intercepts strict sandbox escalation approval requests
Sends bounded session context and planned tool arguments to a configured model route
Spawns a one-shot tool-less reviewer subagent
Applies structured allow or deny decisions to sandbox escalation requests
Reads the in-memory parent transcript and current sandbox policy
Uses the normal model-provider network route
